description: The price of an order before placing it: the same checks and the same price as generate. Nothing is made and nothing is charged. Before sign-in: the public price (reference videos, audio and characters need sign-in, since their seconds and photos count); after: this account's price and balance.

audio.description: Video: false for a silent clip, where the model allows it (audio_optional in list_models).

audio_mode.description: Lip sync (lip_sync in list_models) with two people in one photo and two audio files, one per person (the first is the person on the left). parallel: both tracks share one timeline and are the same length, each silent while the other person speaks: any number of turns. sequential: the first track in full, then the second. Left out: parallel when the two run the same length, sequential otherwise.

audio_urls.description: Reference audio (MP3/WAV): public https links, or upload_media links or ids. Video models only, free; most need an image or a video next to it. Lip-sync models (lip_sync in list_models): the speech the photo says, one file per person in it (make it with speak); the clip runs as long as the speech.

character_id.description: A saved person (create_character): their photos go first among the references and the prompt opens with an identity block. Don't describe their face or hair in the prompt; put the framing first (close-up, medium shot): a small face drifts. Your own image_urls come after their photos. References only: not with image_mode first_frame.

character_ids.description: Two saved people in one order, instead of character_id.

duration.description: Seconds: a video's length; a track's (music, optional: the model picks otherwise); a sound effect's (default 5, priced by the second).

fast.description: The model's faster mode at the same price, where list_models shows fast_mode (LongCat: about 10% quicker, the picture may change a little).

image_mode.description: Video: how image_urls are used. reference (default) — things to bring in; first_frame — the clip opens on the one image; first_last_frame — opens on the first, ends on the second.

image_urls.description: Reference images: public https links, or upload_media links or ids.

lyrics.description: Music: the words to sing, as written (sections like [Verse], [Chorus] help). Leave out for the model to write them from the prompt.

prompt.description: Optional: the prompt doesn't change the price.

resolution.description: For example 1K, 2K, 4K for images; 720p for video.

speaker_boxes.description: Lip sync with two speakers, optional: where each person is, [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max] in the photo's pixels, in the order of audio_urls. Left out: the first track is the person on the left, the second the one on the right.

style.description: Music: genre, mood, instruments, voice, for example lo-fi hip hop, warm Rhodes, female vocal.

video_urls.description: Reference videos (MP4/MOV): public https links, or upload_media links or ids. Video models only; their seconds are billed too.

name: estimate_cost

charge.description: With a key or sign-in: what the order would take from the balance (0 for a test key).

list_price.description: A promo price: the price after promo_until.

promo_until.description: A promo price: when it ends (ISO, UTC). An order placed before then keeps this price.

title: Estimate cost
